responses.text: {Player not in NCR gear} Gotta wonder what the hell a civilian is doing here.
{Player in NCR gear} You from Camp Golf or McCarran? Never mind. Don't really care.
Ranger military outpost. We're keeping an eye on the Legion activities south of here at Cottonwood Cove.
Nothing going on down there at the moment - just the usual slave trafficking. Poor bastards.
What, again? Didn't I just change those damn things? All right, fine - show me the new codes.

topics.prompt: I have updated radio security codes from Sergeant Reyes here.

responses.text: Believe me, I would love orders to take Cottonwood Cove apart and kick the Legion back across the river.
But, the brass at McCarran doesn't want us to waste resources on something they consider a minor target. So we just get to watch.

topics.prompt: The NCR is letting the Legion get away with slavery?

responses.text: Undoubtedly. Rangers are tough nuts to crack, though, and any force small enough to launch a surprise attack isn't going back in one piece.
On the other hand, if the Legion goes for a full-scale attack, we'll see 'em coming, fall back, and wait for reinforcements.
So, we know what they'll do and they know what we'll do, so we just sit around and keep an eye on each other.

topics.prompt: Does the Legion know you're watching them from here?
